ops.title: Remove per-worker Orca subprocess fanout from prompt watching
ops.description: Owner /root; next priority after recurrence delivery. Source confirms prompts.Watch.workers already reads worker-list for every active dispatch, then observeAll/waitOf invokes worker-show once per active dispatch solely to get terminal/server/AgentWait before often returning Clear. Live supervisor66832 showed many simultaneous Orca worker-show children. Relay Desk.show has19call sites across phases too. Next inspect supported bulk worker/terminal observations and reuse fresh data to avoid NCLI launches, preserving remote/unavailable states and fresh safety checks for any session action. Do not add TTL guesses or background scans; user-visible prompt detection and session protections unchanged. No local load/replay/stress tests. One implementation owner, bounded independent review, hosted checks, merge/release/localactivation and passiveproof before done. Held until current recurrence task addc4c4 completes.

ops.text: Unchanged prompt-watch pass avoids one worker-show subprocess per active dispatch using a supported fresh observation path
Prompt, remote/unavailable and mutation freshness semantics remain covered by hosted regressions
Merged signed release installed in live controllers and subprocess reduction verified passively
